status: Conditional closed-form examples; no activity definition, noise law or controller selected
value_lineage: C-17/P-34 serves per-CC flexible activity and residual support; P-35 constrains comparisons. C-29/P-69 requires explicit complete-frame timing. H-74 requires evidence of necessity before adding controller state.
assumptions: Activity fraction is distinct from summed rate, predictive readiness, semantic response and noise-qualified temporal coverage.

The two-cell calculation is a reduction of H-77 net cancellation, not the actual 60+60 network. Each frame adds independent U[0,sigma] drive to each polarity, before cancellation. Neither this noise distribution nor its spatial allocation is selected.

For the feedback calculation, activity deviations around an interior equilibrium obey delta_a_next=rho*delta_a+b*delta_sigma with 0<=rho<1 and b>0. This local reference does not establish these properties for the nonlinear SNN.
An integral error correction illustrates timing dependence only. Its point target is a local reference inside an allowable band, not a replacement of the user flexible regime-dependent envelope.

Controller bounds, saturation, nonlinearity, stochastic fluctuations, activity-estimation filters and learning are absent from the two-dimensional linear calculation. Its stability is local and is not a guarantee for full trajectories.

cancellation_and_activity.observation: Increasing independent noise can reduce threshold-qualified active fraction while increasing expected unsigned rate. A positive control gain for activity cannot be inferred from positive noise drive.
cancellation_and_activity.homogeneous_limit: C(sigma*x)=sigma*C(x) for sigma>=0. If the entire provisional input scales this way and there is no fixed additive drive, fixed-positive-threshold support is nondecreasing in sigma for each realization. The counterexample includes fixed signed drive, so it does not contradict this restricted monotonicity.
cancellation_and_activity.zero_threshold: At d=0, theta=0, every sigma>0 gives active fraction1/2 almost surely. The actual full dense 60+60 positive-drive case likewise has one surviving polarity and50% instantaneous support almost surely under the stated nondegenerate assumptions; meaningful activity qualification is needed.
cancellation_and_activity.limits: No empirical response curve, chosen threshold, CC activity target, stochastic law, or claimed monotonicity for real trajectories follows from the example.

feedback_timing.proof: For lambda^2-T*lambda+D, strict unit-disc stability is equivalent to1-T+D>0,1+T+D>0,1-D>0. Substitution gives the stated bounds for0<=rho<1.
feedback_timing.interpretation: Using the completed destination frame to choose the next transition noise need not violate two-frame isolation. Holding noise fixed within a transition does not by itself choose which completed observation the feedback uses.
feedback_timing.limits: The comparison does not select integral control, prefer a gain, fit rho/b, or require a per-neuron field. There is no universal fastest or slowest adequate control cadence.

bounded_actuation.equilibrium: For a_next=rho*a+b*sigma+d, fixed0<=rho<1,b>0, andsigma in[sigma_min,sigma_max], reachable equilibria lie in[(b*sigma_min+d)/(1-rho),(b*sigma_max+d)/(1-rho)].
bounded_actuation.interpretation: Attention suppression and activity support must be jointly feasible. Reducing added noise to zero cannot generally suppress already excessive external/recurrent drive. No priority policy or additional inhibitory mechanism is selected.

future_comparisons.alternatives: Activity threshold/window definitions using individual rates
future_comparisons.observations: Sensitivity to noise magnitude, transient cancellation, numerically tiny rates and genuine brief participation; preserve activity fraction rather than substituting summed rate.

future_comparisons.alternatives: Feedback based on latest completed activity versus intentionally delayed/averaged observation
future_comparisons.observations: Recovery time, excursions and persistent oscillations across token transitions and after learning; report cadence and units, not just numeric gain.

future_comparisons.alternatives: Fixed primitive noise for mechanism isolation versus full closed-loop regulation
future_comparisons.observations: Separate effects on useful residual, fading, context prediction and steerability; replaying a fixed amplitude does not evaluate full feedback behavior.

future_comparisons.alternatives: Simple bounded correction candidates under attention suppression and activity support
future_comparisons.observations: Reachability of the broad envelope and semantic behavior under actual inputs; add state or more elaborate control only after a simpler justified candidate demonstrably fails.

measurement_circularity: Defining active as a fixed fraction of the largest current rates guarantees that count by definition; it is not evidence that the dynamics achieved activity regulation. Adaptive qualification may be compared, but its measurement meaning and sensitivity to absolute fading must remain explicit.
scope_limit: No neural implementation/training, random neural simulation, benchmark, project tests or build. Exact rational probability and2x2 eigenvalue arithmetic only.

signed_population_noise.scope: One conditional frame, 60 cells per polarity, independent U[0,sigma] addition to each nonnegative provisional rate, then exact H-77 cancellation. Sigma is fixed for this frame; no clipping, recurrence, quantization or feedback dynamics included.

definitions.d: Pre-noise sum of positive rates minus sum of negative rates; d>=0 by symmetry.
definitions.D: Post-noise signed remainder, preserved by exact cancellation.
definitions.distribution: D/sigma = delta + Y-60 where Y is the sum of 120 independent U[0,1] variables.
definitions.absolute_mean: E[abs(D)]/sigma = delta + 2*sum_{k=0}^{floor(60-delta)} (-1)^k binom(120,k)*(60-delta-k)^121 / 121!, with empty sum zero.

normalization.general_population_size_m_each_polarity: Raw-sum net noise variance = m*sigma^2/6; readout divided by m has variance sigma^2/(6*m). Thus neuron-count scaling depends on the defined signal and readout units.
normalization.independent_5120_coordinates: For the raw-sum vector readout, E[||D-d||_2^2]=51200*sigma^2 in this one-frame reference.
normalization.relative_RMS_error: sqrt(51200)*sigma/||d||_2 when ||d||_2>0; not a selected noise budget or prediction metric.

signed_population_noise.interpretation: Unbiased signed noise can increase unsigned remaining activity and change weak coordinate signs. A flipped small component alone need not imply poor whole-vector fidelity. Residual magnitude growth alone is not evidence of strengthened semantic information.
signed_population_noise.checks: 120-uniform formula evaluated with 100- and 150-digit Decimal precision; agreement <1e-65. Independent single-pair triangular formulas checked. Normal approximation reported separately and not used for exact results.
signed_population_noise.non_adoptions: No noise law, amplitude, readout normalization, correlation structure, controller, threshold or stored statistic selected. No actual neural simulation or training claim.

nonlinear_response.status: Conditional one-transition response; no neuron equation or noise law selected
assumptions: 60 cells per polarity; each positive input is delta=.01 and negative input is zero
Every cell independently receives U[0,sigma] before the transfer; sigma fixed within transition
phi(x)=clip((x-theta)/b,0,1), theta=.1, b=.05; identical arbitrary input/output rate units for this reference
H77 cancellation after transfer preserves its signed population sum; no recurrence, quantization or feedback in this calculation

formulas.primitive: J_k(t)=0 for t<=0; t^(k+1)/[(k+1)b^k] for0<t<b; t-k*b/(k+1) for t>=b
formulas.threshold_linear_comparison: For phi(x)=max(x-theta,0),0<delta<theta and sigma>theta: mean increment per cell=delta*(1-theta/sigma)+delta^2/(2sigma), no greater than delta. General1-Lipschitz response cannot amplify same-draw differences above one.

interpretation: Nonlinearity with a sufficiently steep response can convert balanced noise plus a residual into greater mean signed output; cancellation alone does not do so
Noise can enable a previously subthreshold response without guaranteeing reliable contextual information or repeated growth
The larger mean at sigma=.15 has a lower mean/standard-deviation ratio than sigma=.10; neither statistic is adopted as a task metric
Recurrent selective amplification can contribute separately; no new inhibitory connection type or noise-specific amplification component is implied
Changing noise after feedback or composing learned transitions needs the full model, not iteration of the mean formula
nonlinear_response.verification: Exact Fraction antiderivatives independently checked by piecewise polynomial integration for ten noise levels and both first/second moments
nonlinear_response.scope_limit: No stochastic sampling, SNN/training implementation, learned prediction result, benchmark, project test or build

spatial_noise_covariance.scope: Conditional simultaneous additive noise followed by exact H77 active-rate cancellation. No clipping, transfer nonlinearity, recurrence, learned response, controller or neural simulation.

definitions.m: Equal number of cells in each polarity.
definitions.v: Common finite per-cell noise variance, with equal group means.
definitions.rho_w: Pairwise correlation between distinct cells within each polarity.
definitions.general_identity: For signed-sum vector s and covariance Sigma, Var(net noise)=s^T Sigma s.
definitions.validity: The assumed covariance must be positive semidefinite. Listed examples are realizable by independent and shared nonnegative random components; arbitrary rho_w/rho_b pairs are not allowed.
definitions.time: Independent redraw of the complete noise vector at successive frames makes centered fluctuations temporally white in every example; temporal whiteness does not fix simultaneous spatial sharing.

unchanged_net_changed_context.meaning: Equal added group totals cancel in the signed sum but alter the surviving composition. This is one deterministic noise realization, not an average or a trained trajectory.

spatial_noise_covariance.comparison_implication: A shared global noise-amplitude command does not specify shared random draws. Compare semantic response and contextual prediction, not noise amplitude or mean pairwise correlation alone.
spatial_noise_covariance.non_adoptions: No common-noise generator, covariance matrix, decorrelation target, extra state, population change, or new controller selected.
spatial_noise_covariance.verification: Fifteen exact rational covariance-sum identities at m1/2/60; exact H77 composition identity. No network evolution or project tests.
